description: This file 'rolesEdit.php' is a PHP source code for managing user roles within the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing arguments, handling role creation, editing, duplication, rendering the GUI, and managing rights configurations. The file interacts with a database and template system, and defines classes, functions, and control flow for role management functionalities.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: A class representing user roles, with methods for retrieving by ID and writing to the database.

classes.name: tlRight
classes.description: A class representing rights or permissions associated with roles.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes input arguments from request variables.

methods.name: doOperation
methods.description: Performs create, update, or duplication operations on roles based on user input.

methods.name: complete_gui
methods.description: Completes and prepares the GUI data object for rendering role management pages.

methods.name: generateUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique role name by appending a hash and random string.

methods.name: initLabels
methods.description: Initializes labels for GUI display (e.g., action create/edit labels).

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to manage roles.
